decisions.rationale: "hexosaminidase A deficiency" names a single, specific inherited disorder (the hexosaminidase A-deficient form of GM2 gangliosidosis, Tay-Sachs type). The bare word "deficiency" is general, but the full phrase is specific, like "C7 deficiency" in the examples, so the whole span is annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 6; What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms applied only to bare 'deficiency')

decisions.rationale: "pseudodeficiency" describes a benign biochemical state with reduced enzyme activity and no clinical disease, so it does not refer to a disease that should be annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms and non-disease concepts); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease definition)

decisions.rationale: "Tay-Sachs disease" is a single, specific disease with a unique definition and no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: "TSD" is the abbreviation of Tay-Sachs disease given in parentheses right after the long form. Abbreviation definitions are annotated as separate synonymous mentions, so this short form is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: In "screened for TSD carriers", the abbreviation TSD is a disease name used as a modifier of the noun "carriers" (a carrier-status concept), so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers)

decisions.rationale: In "individuals who appeared to be TSD heterozygotes", TSD modifies the noun "heterozygotes", so the disease mention is used as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers)

decisions.rationale: In "a French TSD patient", TSD modifies the noun "patient", so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers)

decisions.rationale: "pseudodeficient" is an adjective describing a clinically benign allele with reduced enzyme activity. It names a non-disease state, not a specific or class disease, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms and non-disease concepts); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease definition)
